Everyone on Earth jumps. Same second. Earthquake, or nothing?
Guess now, comment before the end.
Spread out across the planet, all our pushes cancel out.
So let's cheat. Everyone squeezes into one spot, about the size of a giant city.

text: Earth moves less than the width of a single atom.

Why so tiny? Earth is over ten trillion times heavier than all of us.

text: We land, Earth moves back. Total: nothing.
Twist: one stadium can do more. In twenty eleven, Seattle football fans cheered so hard, a seismometer a block away picked it up.
